name: Two-pass Causal + Wide Autotune Sweep
tagline: Flash-v3-style two-pass causal kernel with fused log2(e)*scale into Q and an enlarged 19-config autotune sweep across (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, num_stages, num_warps).

key_hyperparams.name: scale_fusion
key_hyperparams.role: constant pre-multiply so kernel uses exp2(qk) directly

key_hyperparams.name: two_pass_causal
key_hyperparams.value: non-causal full tiles + causal boundary tile

key_hyperparams.name: non_causal_load_mask
key_hyperparams.role: boundary-check elimination on full pass-1 tiles

init_recovers: flash_v3 baseline at the matching autotune choice (default config set is a strict superset)
diff_from_baseline: Beyond flash_v3 it removes the per-load boundary mask in pass 1 (full tiles) and roughly doubles the autotune search space, including very large BLOCK_M=256 tiles for hdim=64 and small BLOCK_M ∈ {16, 32} tiles for hdim=256 to manage register pressure.

name: Block-Pointer FA + Cast-down Q
tagline: Two-pass causal fused attention using tl.make_block_ptr for Q/K/V/O, with sm_scale pre-multiplied into Q (cast back to Q's dtype) and a 28-config autotune sweep.

key_hyperparams.name: block_ptr
key_hyperparams.role: structured tile addressing for HW-friendly access

key_hyperparams.name: k_layout
key_hyperparams.role: K tile loaded transposed so qk = q · k (no tl.trans)

key_hyperparams.name: scale_fusion
key_hyperparams.value: q *= sm_scale * log2(e); cast back to Q dtype
key_hyperparams.role: fp16/bf16 storage of pre-scaled Q to keep tensor-core path

init_recovers: flash_v3 baseline at the matching autotune choice
diff_from_baseline: Adopts Triton block pointers (tl.make_block_ptr + tl.advance) for all four tensors (eliminating manual mask arithmetic in the inner loops), stores K transposed to drop tl.trans, casts pre-scaled Q back to fp16/bf16 before the loop, and roughly triples the autotune search space.

name: Shape-aware Split + Small Autotune
tagline: Two-pass causal flash attention with a 6-config autotune sweep, plus a fixed (64,32) BLOCK_M/N override for headdim>=256 to reduce register pressure.

key_hyperparams.name: headdim_override
key_hyperparams.role: manual config to dodge autotune misselection

init_recovers: flash_v3 baseline (same kernel structure, smaller tuner)
diff_from_baseline: Compared to flash_v3 it shrinks the autotune sweep to 6 configs and short-circuits the autotuner for headdim >= 256 with a hand-picked (BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=32, num_warps=4, num_stages=4) launch to reduce register pressure on hdim256.

name: Incomplete kernel (no store, no wrapper)
tagline: Two-pass causal kernel body but missing the acc/=l_i normalization, the tl.store, and the entire custom_attention_forward wrapper.

key_hyperparams.name: scale_fusion
key_hyperparams.value: claimed but no wrapper to apply it

diff_from_baseline: The proposal is broken: it deletes the wrapper and the final normalization+store from the FA2 baseline, leaving a kernel that never writes its output, so correctness check (max_diff < 1e-2) fails and the benchmark scores zero.

name: Two-pass Causal + Expanded Autotune (incl hdim256)
tagline: Same two-pass causal FA2 kernel as flash_v3 with a 19-config autotune sweep adding BLOCK_N ∈ {256} and BLOCK_M=256 entries tuned for headdim=256.

key_hyperparams.name: scale_fusion
key_hyperparams.role: pre-multiply so kernel uses exp2 directly

key_hyperparams.name: autotune_configs
key_hyperparams.role: expanded sweep including BLOCK_N=256 and BLOCK_M=256 for hdim256

init_recovers: flash_v3 baseline at the matching autotune choice
diff_from_baseline: Functionally identical kernel to flash_v3; the only material change is enlarging the autotune sweep from 8 to 19 configs, particularly adding BLOCK_N=256, BLOCK_M=256 and num_stages=5 entries aimed at headdim=256.
